name: Brake pads & rotors
alt: Old and replacement brake rotors during a service visit
description: Brake pad and rotor replacement, with a look at visible wear. Tell Josh about squealing, grinding, or vibration when braking.

name: Suspension
alt: Josh working in the wheel well of a red vehicle
short: Get back to a smoother ride.
description: Help with worn suspension components and ride concerns. Share details about clunks, uneven tire wear, or changes in handling.

name: Spark plugs & ignition coils
alt: Open engine bay during vehicle maintenance
short: Give your engine a fresh start.
description: Spark plug and ignition coil replacement for scheduled maintenance or diagnosed ignition issues. Tell Josh about rough running or a misfire.

name: Engine air filters
alt: Josh alongside a vehicle with its engine bay open
short: Fresh air for the miles ahead.
description: Engine air filter inspection and replacement as part of your car’s routine maintenance. Parts and fitment are confirmed for your vehicle.

name: Cabin air filters
alt: A vehicle at a maintenance visit; service work photo
description: Cabin air filter replacement to help keep dust and debris out of the ventilation system. Ask about adding it to your next appointment.

name: Vehicle inspections
alt: Wheel and brake components exposed for inspection
description: Discuss a general visual vehicle check and your maintenance concerns. Josh will confirm what can be inspected at the appointment.
details: Not a state inspection or certification
